claims.head: Don’t expect many shots
claims.body: Philadelphia’s games average only 77.5 unblocked shots per 60 at 5-on-5, both teams combined (31st of 32 for pace); Ottawa’s average 79.3 (25th).
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 4 and 3 games this season

check.measure: unblocked shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5, both teams combined, adjusted for score and venue
check.rule: held if tonight's pace is below the two teams' average; partly if below the league average; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Two of the league’s heaviest-hitting teams
claims.body: Philadelphia’s hit score is 111 (6th of 32) and Ottawa’s is 122 (2nd). 100 is league average, after adjusting for each arena’s scorer.

check.measure: hits per 60 in close games, both teams, as a score against league average (arena-adjusted)
check.rule: held if tonight's combined hit score is at or above the two teams' average; partly if above 100; otherwise didn't happen
